desc: Implement Python solution: read N,S,T; build mapping f[26]; print -1 if any source letter maps to two different targets; handle E==0 -> 0.
Compute E (#sources with f[c]!=c) and image_size; if image_size==26 and E>0 print -1 (full-alphabet/bijection impossibility).
Build nontrivial-edge graph on 26 letters, compute indegrees, find all cycles, count isolated cycles (all cycle nodes indeg==1), and output E + isolated_cycles.
Run the implementation on the 4 provided samples and confirm outputs 4, 0, -1, 4.

Brute-force validate the formula against a BFS minimum-operation search on small random/exhaustive strings (reduced alphabet including a spare letter, all-letters-used cases, multiple isolated cycles, chains into cycles); no counterexamples found.
